answers.core: Besides not being sure whether this could be implemented as an add-on, I think features like this greatly improve the add-ons that can be created avoiding nested dependencies and lowering the barrier towards making useful add-ons.
answers.workaround:
The first issue (the EditorInspector signals not bubbling) can be worked around in my specific case: I simply auto-update the UI every 100ms or so. However, this can be extremely resource intensive if the usecase requires updating more resource-intensive UI.

The second issue cannot be worked around without a lot of digging through the editor UI, which would be very inconvenient and could theoretically change in-between versions.
